projectDescription: Nestled in the picturesque landscape of Wolfsthal, Austria, d7bau presents an exclusive collection of luxury residences that epitomize architectural excellence and timeless elegance. Each home is meticulously crafted to blend harmoniously with the natural surroundings while offering unparalleled comfort and sophistication.

companyDescription: We are a dynamic construction company focused on building and reconstructing family houses in Austria. We build from all basic types of building materials (brick, aerated concrete, wood, Wolf-Thermomodulen®). We also design buildings in Austria and handle the entire process of obtaining building permits.
